title: Cubical tensor differential expanded into reindexed, uncancelled faces
statement:
Let $r\geq0$, let $v\in\mathbf Z^r$, and let $I\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$ be finite. Use the free cubical chains [def-weil-pbc-free-module], cells $[v,A]$, standard vectors $u_i$, and signed cubical boundary of [lem-sfb-integral-lattice-cubical-contraction]. Write $u_A=\sum_{i\in A}u_i$, $\epsilon(A,C)=(-1)^{\#\{(a,c)\in A\times C:c<a\}}$, and $P(v,I)=\sum_{A\subseteq I}\epsilon(A,I\setminus A)[v,A]\otimes[v+u_A,I\setminus A]$. The tensors are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], in the total chain complex [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] with differential $d_T(x\otimes y)=dx\otimes y+(-1)^a x\otimes dy$ on bidegree $(a,b)$. For each $i\in I$, $B\subseteq I\setminus\{i\}$, put $C=(I\setminus\{i\})\setminus B$, $A=B\cup\{i\}$, and $E=C\cup\{i\}$. Then, before any shuffle-sign simplification or cancellation,
$$\begin{aligned}
d_TP(v,I)=\sum_{i\in I}\sum_{B\subseteq I\setminus\{i\}}\bigl(&\epsilon(A,C)(-1)^{\#\{a\in A:a<i\}}([v+u_i,A\setminus\{i\}]\otimes[v+u_A,C]-[v,A\setminus\{i\}]\otimes[v+u_A,C])\\
&+\epsilon(B,E)(-1)^{|B|+\#\{c\in E:c<i\}}([v,B]\otimes[v+u_B+u_i,E\setminus\{i\}]-[v,B]\otimes[v+u_B,E\setminus\{i\}])\bigr).
\end{aligned}$$
All terms are in total degree $|I|-1$. If $I=\varnothing$, the differential and the outer sum are zero, including $r=0$.

proof.text: Evaluate the free linear extension P on [v,I]. For each subset A of I put C=I\A. Disjointness and |A|+|C|=|I| place its tensor in total degree |I|. Linearity distributes the total differential across the finite powerset sum and its shuffle coefficients. On bidegree (a,b), its two terms are d tensor 1 and (-1)^a times 1 tensor d. Expand each cubical cell boundary and distribute the tensor over its finite sum and subtraction by bilinearity. The resulting first faces are indexed by A disjoint union C=I and i in A; second faces by the same partitions and i in C. Their coefficients are respectively epsilon(A,C)(-1)^#{a in A:a<i} and epsilon(A,C)(-1)^|A|(-1)^#{c in C:c<i}.

proof.text: For a first face remove i from A and call the result B. This gives i in I and a partition B disjoint union C=I\{i}; insertion of i into B is its inverse. For a second face remove i from C, giving the same remaining partition; insertion into its second part is the inverse. Disjointness guarantees i is absent from both remaining parts. Reindex both finite sums by these bijections, and parametrize the remaining partition by B subset I\{i} and C=(I\{i})\B. Keep each coefficient and each of its two tensor terms unchanged: this is the displayed formula, before signs are simplified and before middle terms cancel. If I is empty, both factors have degree zero and the total differential and outer sum both vanish; this covers rank zero as well.

theorem partitionDifferentialFaces (r : ℕ) (v : Fin r → ℤ) (I : Finset (Fin r)) :
    ((HomologicalComplex.tensorObj (chainComplex r) (chainComplex r)).d
        I.card (I.card - 1))
      (diagonalComponent r I.card (cell r (I.card : ℤ) v I)) =
      ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ B ∈ (I.erase i).powerset,
        ((partitionSign r (insert i B) (I.erase i \ B) *
            (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((insert i B).filter (fun j ↦ j < i)).card) •
          (tensorCell r (I.card - 1) (v + unitVector r i)
              (v + directionSum r (insert i B)) ((insert i B).erase i) (I.erase i \ B) -
            tensorCell r (I.card - 1) v (v + directionSum r (insert i B))
              ((insert i B).erase i) (I.erase i \ B)) +
        (partitionSign r B (insert i (I.erase i \ B)) * (-1 : ℤ) ^ B.card *
            (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((insert i (I.erase i \ B)).filter (fun j ↦ j < i)).card) •
          (tensorCell r (I.card - 1) v (v + directionSum r B + unitVector r i) B
              ((insert i (I.erase i \ B)).erase i) -
            tensorCell r (I.card - 1) v (v + directionSum r B) B
              ((insert i (I.erase i \ B)).erase i)))
